shared_elements: elaborate headdress or headgear above the face
central figure occupying the full vertical field
low-relief incised curvilinear ornament on the torso/chest area
horizontal banding across the lower body
justification: Both depict a blocky frontal anthropomorphic figure with a prominent headdress dominating a vertical field, its torso covered with schematic low-relief curvilinear ornament including disc-like and banded elements, rendered in the same broad convention of rounded, heavily stylised relief with squat proportions. The clearest difference in content is that B sets its central figure between flanking subsidiary faces/figures in profile-like relief across a rectangular panel, whereas A is a single isolated massive figure with a scrolled shoulder/headdress panel and no flanking companions, and the arm-and-hand gesture visible in B has no counterpart in A.
